# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities by emailing
security-contact@example.com. Do not open a public issue for security reports.

Include enough detail for maintainers to understand and reproduce the issue:

* Affected version, branch, or commit
* Steps to reproduce
* Expected impact
* Any proof of concept, logs, or screenshots that help explain the issue

## Response Timeline

Maintainers will acknowledge receipt within 5 business days. After triage, we
will share the expected remediation path when possible.

## Disclosure

Please allow maintainers time to investigate and prepare a fix before public
disclosure. We will coordinate disclosure timing with the reporter when the
issue is confirmed.
